authorized_user_scope: Preserve retained model; compare original, TabM, ModernNCA, TabICL; same budget, five paired splits; all work E; no manuscript
retained_method: MAT-PV; formulas and hyperparameters from completed TON benchmark
adapter_changes_only: Native class count/roles and feature schema
Undefined missing-class comparator returns no evidence, not a forced promotion
Hardware-only batch fallback before experimental outcomes
Official TabICL cache disabled for >10 observed classes; eight members and all rows unchanged
cohort_rule: Class-stratified input-hash cohort: up to 20,000 normal and 2,000 each native attack after same-input/same-label dedup; restore entire cross-label groups. All actual labels retained. Explicitly not full corpus/natural prevalence.
features: Exclude target, attempted flags, row indices, source class directory, IPs, ports, timestamps, payload IDs. Signed log1p numeric values, canonical float32 grouping. Fixed published-standard categorical vocabulary where configured.
split_rule: 20% group-stratified test; 2000 normal plus100 protected-class calibration labels; focus absent from source and protected source<=20;80% other available groups, source total<=30000; remainder unlabeled target. Exact-input groups never cross roles.
shared_acquisition: Same retained tree blind50+graph-corrected entropy20; do not force discovery of focus class; same queried labels for all arms
other_labels: All source labels +2000 normal calibration labels +100 protected-class validation labels identical and disclosed for all arms;70 is additional target reviews, not total labels
preprocessing_fit: Source-only distance median/IQR; source-only learned schema unless fixed category vocabulary. Deep standardization/bins fit within selection-fitting fold then refit on all shared training.
threshold_rule: Each model independently uses identical 99% normal-calibration order statistic, strict >. No threshold tuning on external test.
model_training: Pinned official sources/checkpoint as TON;200epoch cap,20patience; ordinary and inverse-frequency loss both retained, no test-based variant choice; TabICL8members,official repr cache for <=10 observed classes and cache=False for >10 (official hierarchical path),all context,multi-class hierarchy enabled
hardware: CPU1thread trees; RTX3050Laptop4GB GPU deep/TabICL; synthetic full-shape hardware preflight256,128,64 before outcomes, no silent row subsampling
primary_report: Mean ± SD and paired percentage-point differences over all5overlapping group splits; two low-label role attacks mean F1, all-class macroF1, per-role precision/correct-type recall/any-attack alarm recall,FPR,efficiency
rare_f1_definition: Arithmetic mean subtype F1 of predeclared protected scarce-label and source-absent focus attack; not all rarest native classes
evaluation_barrier: Freeze all completed predictions and recorded failures before test metrics. No method changes after barrier. No dropping failures or poor seeds.
claim_limits: No XSS label. ARP poisoning and Slowloris keep their actual native meanings. No timestamps/host/flow identifiers for independent-session/temporal claims.
Five overlapping splits are not five independent datasets.
Record-group random evaluation cannot establish deployment, temporal or cross-device generalization.
No guaranteed improvement, SOTA claim, significance or publication outcome.
